issue: Every briefed turn now pays one extra durable-clock read on the user's prompt path: recordRouteReceipt calls directiveLifecycleStore.clock(sessionId) here, and applyDirectiveLifecycle (line 607) then asks the same file-backed store once more through decideDirectiveLifecycleDelivery's evaluate call. Measured on this checkout with the real file store, one clock() call is a helper spawn costing 35-46 ms, so a Claude turn that already spent one helper spawn now spends two, and a runtime that sends no transcript (Pi, DSH: validTranscript fails, so dedup spends none) gains its first. Case: any live turn with a passing route and a brief. Fix: have applyDirectiveLifecycle surface the clock it already observed, or read the clock once and pass it to both the receipt write and the dedup decision, so the receipt is stamped from the same observation.

issue: The confirmed-session rule this change depends on is now written three times in one file: deliveryStateOptionsFor at line 267 (input.session_identity_confirmed ?? hasSessionId), the new receiptSessionId at lines 336-343, and the extracted applyDirectiveLifecycle at line 441. The change adds a second consumer of `SPECKIT_DIRECTIVE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_DIR` without naming it in the variable's docs. `routeReceiptBaseDir` (`hooks/lib/route-receipt.ts:97-100`) resolves the new route-receipt store's base from `DIRECTIVE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_DIR_ENV`, and the store writes under `<base>/route-receipts` (`:76`, `:224-225`).
